title: 第9章 他给的实在太多辣第10章 天外飞仙
lines: 经历了刺激的一夜，加上走走停停，许平秋精神虽然还亢奋，但身体却很实在的饿了。
他从怀中拿出了一个玉瓶，顺着光源，玉瓶变得十分通透，映照出里面存放的圆润丹药。
这是辟谷丹，但从之前那什么超大颗清心丹来看，许平秋感觉这辟谷丹应该也不是什么正常的东西。
至少，它晃动的时候不该发出金铁敲击的声音。
听起来不太像是丹药，有种一堆小铁球在瓶中滚动的感觉。
要不是胃催促的紧，许平秋这才迫不得已才倒出了一颗，捏在手中，郑重的审视着。
外观看起来虽然很像麦丽素，但却没有脆生生的感觉，捏起来硬的很，宛如精铁浇筑的铁弹。
犹豫了一会，许平秋决定还是尝试一下，或许这个世界炼的丹药就是这画风呢！
“这玩意吞下去确定能消化吗？”
许平秋含着辟谷丹，尝试用牙齿咬了一下，果不其然是咬不动的。
他有些不确信是不是这样吃了，万一这东西有特殊的吃法就不妙了。
他可不想为这个世界贡献上一种创新性的死法。
“虽然它看起来有点硬，但吞下去是能消化的。”乐临清肯定的说道。
有着乐临清的肯定，许平秋才忐忑的吞了下去。
然后他问向乐临清：“那你要吗？”
乐临清立刻摇了摇头，拒绝的十分的快，“不用，我已经可以自行辟谷了！”
有那么一瞬间，许平秋在考虑要不要哕出来，但这辟谷丹下沉的速度有点快，几下就沉到胃里了。
对此，许平秋只能安慰自己这辟谷丹其实就是一个超级压缩饼干，不碍事。
摆脱辟谷丹带来的震撼后，许平秋又询问道：“话说，在这个地方，她们还能追上来吗？”
毕竟他只是个朴实无华的凡人，感受不到这地方和外界有什么区别，也不知道修行者还能剩下什么能力。
“唔…好像能，我中招了，她或许凭借这个感应到我的位置。”
乐临清拍了拍自己滚烫的脸颊，言语间不由有些懊悔。
正常情况下她肯定能考虑到这事，但欲神瘴的影响除了身体外，令她的思绪也受制的十分明显，基本上很难主动去思考什么事情，只能被动的作出反应。
“不能隔绝吗？”许平秋顿时感觉有些棘手了，原本以为是躲猫猫，没想到对面卑鄙的开透视。
“只能强行涤除，但我一定会失去心智，到时候……”
乐临清抿了抿嘴，没有继续往下说。
见状许平秋也不再考虑，只是又想到了一个解决办法，说道：“那这地方是不是会把她们变得和普通人一样，我提着你这剑能不能追着她们砍？”
许平秋搓了搓手，感觉这理论上好像可行。
乐临清摇了摇头，说道：“不行的，你忘记我能把你拎着走了吗？”
许平秋不解的问：“但这地方不是限制灵力吗？”
“可是，我体内还有灵力啊，只是离体很快会消散，而且我这剑也很厉害的，若不是我炼化了，我也不一定能提起来。”
乐临清柔声解释着，此时她也意识到情况不太妙，但却很难想出应对之计。
“那你现在还能动手吗？”许平秋问。
“很勉强，而且动手后我估计就会彻底的无力，她们也不会那么愚蠢上前送死。”
“不过要是真被追上了，你可以直接抛弃我逃走，我会将那两个人留下来的，你有辟谷丹和百兽粉，这地方应该困不住你。”
乐临清认真的说道，她的言语中有一种将许平秋卷入此事的愧疚。
content_en:
After an exciting night with lots of walking and walking, Xu Pingqiu was still in high spirits, but his body was really hungry.
He took out a jade bottle from his arms. Following the light source, the jade bottle became very transparent, reflecting the round elixir stored inside.
This is the Bigu Pill, but judging from the huge Qingxin Pill before, Xu Pingqiu feels that this Bigu Pill is not something normal.
At least, it shouldn't make the sound of gold and iron knocking when it shakes.
It doesn't sound like a pill, it feels like a bunch of small iron balls rolling in a bottle.
If it weren't for the tightness of his stomach, Xu Pingqiu would have no choice but to pour out one, hold it in his hand, and examine it solemnly.
Although it looks very similar to Malisin in appearance, it doesn't feel crispy and is very hard when pinched, like an iron bullet made of fine iron.
After hesitating for a while, Xu Pingqiu decided to give it a try. Maybe the elixirs made in this world are painted in this style!
"Are you sure you can digest this thing if you swallow it?"
Xu Pingqiu held the Bigu Pill in his mouth and tried to bite it with his teeth. As expected, he couldn't bite it.
He was a little unsure if he ate it this way, it would be bad if there was a special way to eat it.
He didn't want to contribute an innovative way to die to the world.
"Although it looks a bit hard, it can be digested if swallowed." Le Linqing said with certainty.
With Le Linqing's affirmation, Xu Pingqiu swallowed it nervously.
Then he asked Xiang Le Linqing: "Do you want it?"
Le Linqing immediately shook his head and refused very quickly, "No, I can already live without food on my own!"
"..."
For a moment, Xu Pingqiu considered whether to spit it out, but the Bigu Pill sank a little too fast, and it sank into his stomach after a few times.
In this regard, Xu Pingqiu could only console himself that the Bigu Pill was actually a super compressed biscuit and would not be in the way.
After getting rid of the shock caused by Bigu Pill, Xu Pingqiu asked again: "By the way, can they still catch up in this place?"
After all, he is just a simple mortal. He can't feel the difference between this place and the outside world, and he doesn't know what abilities a practitioner has left.
"Hmm... It seems possible. I was hit. She might be able to sense my location through this."
Le Linqing patted his hot cheeks and couldn't help feeling a little regretful as he spoke.
Under normal circumstances, she would definitely consider this matter, but the effects of Miasma of Desire not only affected her body, but her thoughts were also very obviously restricted. Basically, it was difficult for her to actively think about anything, and she could only react passively.
"Can't we isolate it?" Xu Pingqiu suddenly felt a little troubled. He originally thought it was a peek-a-boo, but he didn't expect the other person to use X-ray despicably.
"I can only remove it by force, but I will definitely lose my mind. By then..."
Le Linqing pursed her lips and did not continue.
Seeing this, Xu Pingqiu stopped thinking about it, and just thought of another solution, saying: "Then will this place turn them into the same as ordinary people? Can I chase them and chop them with your sword?"
Xu Pingqiu rubbed his hands and felt that this seemed feasible in theory.
Le Linqing shook his head and said, "No, have you forgotten that I can carry you away?"
Xu Pingqiu asked puzzledly: "But doesn't this place limit spiritual power?"
"However, I still have spiritual power in my body, but it will dissipate quickly after leaving the body. Moreover, my sword is also very powerful. If I hadn't refined it, I might not be able to lift it."
Le Linqing explained softly. At this time, she also realized that the situation was not good, but it was difficult to think of a way to deal with it.
"Then can you still take action now?" Xu Pingqiu asked.
"It's very reluctant, and after taking action, I will probably be completely powerless, and they won't be so stupid to step forward and die."
"But if we are really caught up, you can just abandon me and run away. I will keep those two people behind. You have Bigu Pill and Hundred Beasts Powder, so this place shouldn't be able to trap you."
Le Linqing said seriously, and there was a sense of guilt in her words for involving Xu Pingqiu in this matter.
title_en: Chapter 9: What he gave was too spicy Chapter 10: Flying Fairy from Heaven
